subject: Public Comments Form
comment: I live in Little Valley below the Old FAA dirt road below the cliffs NW of the airport. There are major problems with the land being trashed and abused. There is graffiti, dumping of couches regularly over the cliffs in front of our homes, golf balls being hit into our houses and onto the airport runway, as Paul Curtis who manages the airport operations has confirmed. Paul and I have talked and agree the dirt road needs to be blocked from vehicle access because of the seriousness and frequency of the problems. Drugs and illegal activity and fires have happened up there as well. I have a Google drive with over 100 images and videos I've taken of the damage and problems we are having with the cliffs. I talked to Mr. McArthur with the Trust Lands who owns the top of the cliff and he confirmed the city owns below the cliffs and should be responsible for maintenence and cleanup. He said he would look into how to possibly close the dirt road to vehicles. It is not right that neighbors have had to do all the clean up, put their money together to hire a clean up crew in the past, and constantly call the cops over illegal activities. There are 2 areas trashed from someone living there homeless it appears. When neighbors confront teens misusing the land, we and our homes become targets, as I have learned first hand. Cameron Cutler called me last week after talking to both Paul Curtis from the airport and Mr. McArthur with the Trust Lands and he tried to say the trust lands is responsible, but McArthur said he told Cameron the city is. This needs to be clarified and the responsible parties need to act to clean up, manage, and protect this area and homeowners. There is no signage telling people not to dump or drive dirt bikes across the street from our homes. Grafitti is getting worse, and couches are dumped on a regular basis. Please work to remedy this. Please let me know who to email the Google drive link to.
